aboutBlock.title: About us?
aboutBlock.p1: HackChain is an educational-labor ecosystem that links Talent, Educators, and Recruiters in order to promote constant learning and transparency in recruitment processes.
aboutBlock.p2: We believe Web3 technology should be accessible, decentralized, and designed to empower real users. Our goal is to accompany professionals in their growth with immutable tools and credentials that truly make a difference.
aboutBlock.p3: Our vision is to become the global standard for talent verification, creating a world where every acquired skill is recognized globally without barriers or intermediaries, effectively bridging the gap between education and employment.

items.question: What is HackChain?
items.answer: HackChain is an educational-labor ecosystem that links Talent, Educators, and Recruiters in order to promote constant learning and transparency in recruitment processes.

items.question: What is a tokenized certificate?
items.answer: A tokenized certificate is an NFT that contains all the information of a traditional certificate. This NFT is immutable, non-transferable, unforgeable and can only be owned by one person — one Talent.

items.question: What benefits do I get if I register as Talent?
items.answer: You will own a portfolio of certificates to share at any time and will have access to a large number of courses, conferences, and more from Educators in different areas of knowledge.

items.question: What benefits do I get if I register as Educator?
items.answer: Educators can issue certificates to any Talent within the ecosystem quickly and make their educational material known to each of them.

items.question: What benefits do I get if I register as Recruiter?
items.answer: As a Recruiter you can view all Talents within HackChain and the certificates they hold, to strategically offer a job vacancy to the best candidate.
